findings.description: A parameter token without '=' is now stored with the boolean value True. get_encoding_from_headers then calls .strip() on that value when the key is 'charset', which raises AttributeError.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a response header such as 'Content-Type: text/html; charset' (bare charset token, no '='). The new code sets params['charset'] = True, so get_encoding_from_headers reaches params['charset'].strip(...) on a bool. Mechanism: the value is no longer a string, but the caller assumes it is. Impact: accessing response.encoding, or any code path that reads it, raises an exception on a malformed header that previously returned a fallback encoding.
